+++ b/services/calculator.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Service for safe mathematical operations."""
+
+def calculate_ratio(dividend: float, divisor: float) -> float:
+    """Calculates ratio handling zero division safely."""
+    if divisor == 0:
+        return 0.0
+    return dividend / divisor
diff --git a/tests/test_calculator.py b/tests/test_calculator.py
index e69de29..8a7c1b2 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+from services.calculator import calculate_ratio
+
+def test_calculate_ratio_normal():
+    assert calculate_ratio(10, 2) == 5.0
+
+def test_calculate_ratio_zero():
+    assert calculate_ratio(10, 0) == 0.0
